content: WASM binary size toolkit: twiggy 0.8.0 (June 2025) analyzes call graph retained sizes; run 'twiggy top -n 20 file.wasm' to find top contributors. wasm-opt (Binaryen) post-processes .wasm with -Os or -Oz for 15-20% additional shrinkage beyond rustc; wasm-pack runs it automatically in release mode. cargo-bloat 0.12.1 does crate-level size accounting for native binaries. wasm-snip 0.4.0 (2019, unmaintained) replaces function bodies with unreachable; low priority. wee_alloc archived Aug 2025 and unmaintained — do NOT use; prefer default allocator or talc. For CI tracking: build .wasm, record size with 'wc -c', compare against committed baseline.
